::: {.intro}
I'm a financial analyst finishing an M.Sc. in Finance at the University of Münster. I bring valuation experience from around 20 investment-banking projects, controlling and reporting work at Nestlé Nespresso, and empirical research that uses NLP and machine learning to study how information moves asset prices.

On this site you'll find the work itself: the question, the data, the method and what I found.

## Featured work

### [Do FOMC Statements Move Asset Prices Beyond the Rate Decision?](research/fomc-study.qmd)

::: {.tags}
[Python]{.tag} [NLP]{.tag} [Transformers]{.tag} [Event study]{.tag}
:::

Five text measures of Fed communication, from a hawkishness dictionary to transformer models, tested on 239 FOMC meetings. The policy surprise explains the market move; the wording adds almost nothing.
:::

### [Personality Differences and Investment Decisions](research/personality-investment.qmd)

::: {.tags}
[R]{.tag} [Regression]{.tag} [Mediation analysis]{.tag} [Survey data]{.tag}
:::

German household panel data (SOEP) on how the Big Five traits shape stock ownership. Openness works almost entirely through risk tolerance, with an inverse-U pattern.
:::
